title: 1. Pulling Monthly Reports from Accounting, Payroll & Field Portals
workflows: 14 Production Portals · 6 Reliability Gates (n = 84 portal-gate trials)
short_summary: Logging into QuickBooks, ServiceTitan, BuildOps, Gusto, and Shopify to export complete monthly reports without dropping rows.
plain_english_description: Extracting complete, reconciled ledgers, AP bills, payroll journals, and job-cost tables across 84 portal-gate trials (14 production portals x 6 reliability gates: QuickBooks Online, ServiceTitan, BuildOps, Housecall Pro, LMN, Roofr, MarketSharp, Rippling, Gusto, Ramp, Brex, Settle, Finaloop, and Shopify) without session lockouts or silent row truncation.

what_models_do_well: Unassisted Playwright scripts pass 60 of 84 portal-gate trials (71.4% with Sol 6.1 / Opus 5.5; 54 of 84 = 64.3% with unassisted GPT-5.6 Terra), while vision-based browser agents (35 of 84 = 41.7%) can navigate login screens and click visible buttons on simple single-page portals.
where_raw_models_fail: Unassisted vision browser agents fail on 49 of 84 portal-gate trials (58.3% failure rate) and silently truncate 24 of 84 trials (28.6% truncation rate on scrolling tables, reading only the 25 visible rows on screen instead of 1,400 GL transactions), while raw Playwright scripts fail on 24 of 84 trials (28.6%) and silently truncate 10 of 84 trials (11.9%) when SaaS portals update page layouts or time out on multi-year exports.
how_level_playbooks_solve_it: Level's browser extraction playbooks pull native CSV/JSON exports directly, split multi-year pulls into monthly windows, verify the exact client company ID before downloading, and cross-check every export against the trial balance so zero rows are ever silently dropped (84 of 84 = 100.0% extraction completeness).
